# Applicability domain of the blinded compounds (generated by `cypmode/challenge/applicability_domain.py`)

The reliability of the final stack is measured on held-out outer folds of the nested validation, cut by the nearest-training similarity (ECFP4 Tanimoto) of each held-out compound to the rows its fold was trained on. The intervals resample whole chemical series (Butina clusters at Tanimoto 0.6). A bin is *supported* when the lower end of its 95% bootstrap interval is at least 0.60, *weak* when it holds at least 100 compounds but a lower end below that, and *unsupported* when it holds fewer than 100. Cross-validation numbers are read by their shape across bins; they are not forecasts of the leaderboard.
